newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates up, spots down.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates up, spots down.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed up on Monday with a new domestic A share issue in Shenzhen on Tuesday pushing up demand on the repo market, traders said.
The most active seven-day contract rose to 14.5 percent from 10 percent last Friday.
Total turnover rose sharply to 13.39 million lots from 4.6 million. One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.
Traders said the issue of Jiamusi Papermaking Co Ltd in Shenzhen on Tuesday was the major reason for big institutions to borrow money on the Shanghai repo market today.
